svg.title: Dell Axim X51v: PXA270 GPIO map
svg.text: PXA270 GPIOs 0-120 on the Dell Axim X51v (RetroPane, 2026-10-18)
Lines with a known or suspected job; confidence and evidence per line in docs/hw/datasheet.md section 3. The keypad uses its controller pins (keypad.md).
No known job on this board
VID = core-voltage select (GPIO3/4/38). GPIO83 high = headphones in (codec powered). GPIO12/13 low = card in. GPIO99 high = board reset.
